subject.title: [Feature Request]: Multi-lane concurrency support for sub-agents via sessions_spawn

question: Should `sessions_spawn` select administrator-declared sub-agent lanes, and how should lane caps compose with global and per-target-agent limits?
rationale: The missing capability is proven, but this choice establishes a lasting model-facing tool parameter and compatibility-sensitive configuration contract.

options.title: Declared lanes with composed caps
options.body: Configure bounded lane IDs, retain `subagent` as the default, and enforce every applicable global, lane, and target capacity constraint.

options.title: Target-agent partitions only
options.body: Derive isolation from the child agent identity and avoid adding a public lane parameter.

options.title: Dynamic free-form lanes
options.body: Allow callers to create validated lane names at spawn time and manage their capacity dynamically.

recommendation.title: Declared lanes with composed caps
recommendation.body: Configure bounded lane IDs, retain `subagent` as the default, and enforce every applicable global, lane, and target capacity constraint.

likelyOwner.reason: The tool introduction, concurrency resolver provenance, ACP isolation work, and issue participation make this the strongest available decision owner.
